name: @pipeworx/mcp-icypeas

tools.name: icypeas_find_email
tools.description: Find a work email by first name, last name and company domain/name, via Icypeas. Icypeas runs searches asynchronously server-side; this call waits for the result rather than handing back a bare task id. Example: icypeas_find_email({ first_name: "Patrick", last_name: "Collison", domain_or_company: "stripe.com", _apiKey: "your-icypeas-key" })

first_name.description: Person's first name — can be empty if last_name is given.

last_name.description: Person's last name — can be empty if first_name is given.

domain_or_company.description: Company domain or company name, e.g. "stripe.com" or "Stripe".

_apiKey.description: Your Icypeas API key (get one from the API section of your icypeas.com dashboard).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-icypeas forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the icypeas pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
